theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiRH_tangentPlane_restrict_open
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (θ : ℝ), IsOpen W → x ∈ W → HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P θ → HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n (μ.restrict W) x P θ
